## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run pytest` passes
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .` and `uv run ruff format --check .` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated (offline, no real API calls, Windows-safe)
- [ ] Docs updated (`README.md`, `docs/`) if behaviour, options or output changed
- [ ] Entry under "Unreleased" in `CHANGELOG.md` for user-visible changes
- [ ] Price changes cite the provider's pricing page and update `as_of` in `prices.toml`
